<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @outstaff/core run docs:schema`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The team config lives at `.outstaff/team.yaml` in your repository. For a prose tour of the sections, see [Team config](/concepts/team-config/). Problems found by `ost validate` are listed in [Validation codes](/reference/validation-codes/). The same schema is published as JSON Schema in `packages/core/schema/team.schema.json`.

Paths use `[]` for list items and `<key>` for a map entry whose key you choose.

## Example

A complete file for the synthetic team "acme".

```yaml
# Synthetic example: the "acme" team does not exist. All names, handles,
# addresses and URLs below are made up. It is used by tests and docs.

# Schema version of this file; currently 1.
version: 1

# Who the team is.
team:
  name: acme
  product: Acme Shop
  description: The team that builds and runs Acme Shop.

# Trusted humans. Optional; when omitted, trusted humans are repo writers and full chat-workspace members.
humans:
  - name: Ada Admin
    identities:
      vcs: ada-admin
      tracker: ada.admin
      chat: U0ADA0001
      email: ada@acme.example
  - name: Grace Lead
    identities:
      vcs: grace-lead
      chat: U0GRACE02

# Which catalog of roles and skills the team uses.
catalog:
  version: 0.0.0

# Repositories the team works in; at least one.
repos:
  - name: shop
    url: github.com/acme-example/shop
    kind: primary
    checks:
      - pnpm lint
      - pnpm vitest related --run
  - name: infra
    url: github.com/acme-example/infra
    kind: infra
  - name: design-system
    url: github.com/acme-example/design-system
    kind: baseline
  - name: docs-site
    url: github.com/acme-example/docs-site
    kind: other

# The agents on the team; may be empty.
people:
  - handle: priya
    name: Priya Raman
    pronouns: she/her
    role: pm
    identities:
      vcs: acme-priya[bot]
    repos:
      "*": read
      docs-site: write
  - handle: tomas
    name: Tomas Novak
    pronouns: he/him
    role: product
    identities:
      vcs: acme-tomas[bot]
    repos:
      "*": read
      docs-site: write
  - handle: mira
    name: Mira Okafor
    pronouns: she/her
    role: architect
    extends: [developer]
    identities:
      vcs: acme-mira[bot]
    repos:
      shop: write
      "kind:baseline": read
  - handle: leo
    name: Leo Fischer
    pronouns: he/him
    role: designer
  - handle: sam
    name: Sam Duarte
    pronouns: they/them
    role: developer
    identities:
      vcs: acme-sam[bot]
    repos:
      shop: write
      "kind:baseline": read
  - handle: noor
    name: Noor Haddad
    pronouns: she/her
    role: developer
    identities:
      vcs: acme-noor[bot]
    repos:
      shop: write
      "kind:baseline": read
  - handle: ines
    name: Ines Varga
    pronouns: she/her
    role: reviewer
    identities:
      vcs: acme-ines[bot]
    repos:
      "*": read
  - handle: kofi
    name: Kofi Mensah
    pronouns: he/him
    role: devops
    identities:
      vcs: acme-kofi[bot]
    repos:
      infra: write
      shop: read

# Which adapters connect Outstaff to your tools.
integrations:
  chat:
    adapter: slack
  vcs:
    adapter: github
  runtime:
    adapter: claude-agent-sdk
  tracker:
    adapter: itsaplan
    url: https://tracker.acme.example
    project: SHOP
  knowledge:
    adapter: itsaplan
  avatars:
    adapter: dicebear
    style: notionists

# How work moves through the team.
workflow:
  preset: kanban
  statuses:
    backlog: Backlog
    ready: Ready
    active: In Progress
    review: In Review
    blocked: Blocked
    done: Done
    canceled: Canceled

# Team-wide guardrails and message style.
policies:
  messages:
    max_lines: 3
```

## Fields

## version

Schema version of this file; currently 1.

- Type: `number`
- Required
- Must be `1`

## team

Who the team is.

- Type: `object`
- Required

### team.name

Team slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1
- Maximum length 40
- Must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`

### team.product

Name of the product the team builds.

- Type: `string`
- Optional

### team.description

One-line description of the team.

- Type: `string`
- Optional

## humans

Trusted humans. Optional; when omitted, trusted humans are repo writers and full chat-workspace members.

- Type: `list of object`
- Optional

## humans[]

A trusted human.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### humans[].name

Display name of the trusted human.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

### humans[].identities

How this human is known on each connected system; at least one is required.

- Type: `object`
- Required

#### humans[].identities.vcs

Username on the VCS host.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### humans[].identities.tracker

Username or id in the issue tracker.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### humans[].identities.chat

Username or id in the chat workspace.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### humans[].identities.email

Email address.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

## catalog

Which catalog of roles and skills the team uses.

- Type: `object`
- Required

### catalog.version

Exact catalog release this team uses, for example "1.0.0"; must match the catalog in the agent images.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

### catalog.path

Directory of ejected catalog files, relative to this file.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Default: `catalog`
- Minimum length 1

## repos

Repositories the team works in; at least one.

- Type: `list of object`
- Required
- Minimum items 1

## repos[]

A repository the team works in.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### repos[].name

Short name used to refer to this repository in grants.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1
- Maximum length 40
- Must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`

### repos[].url

Repository location: host/owner/repo, an https URL or a git@ address.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Must match `^(https?:\/\/\S+|git@\S+:\S+|[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\/[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+)$`

### repos[].kind

Role of the repository: primary (the product, at most one), baseline, infra or other.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Allowed values: `primary`, `baseline`, `infra`, `other`

### repos[].default_branch

Branch that pull requests target.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Default: `main`
- Minimum length 1

### repos[].checks

Commands an agent runs before pushing, covering only what a change affects (for example lint and the tests related to changed files). CI runs the full suite. When omitted, agents work out the affected checks themselves.

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional
- Minimum items 1

### repos[].checks[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

## people

The agents on the team; may be empty.

- Type: `list of object`
- Required

## people[]

An AI agent on the team.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### people[].handle

Unique lowercase handle; used as the agent's hostname label and mention name.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1
- Maximum length 30
- Must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`

### people[].name

Display name of the agent.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

### people[].pronouns

Pronouns shown in the agent's profile.

- Type: `string`
- Optional

### people[].role

Catalog role this agent plays, for example "developer".

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

### people[].extends

Extra catalog roles or skill bundles layered on top of the role.

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional

### people[].extends[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

### people[].model

LLM model for this agent; the runtime adapter's default when omitted.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

### people[].identities

How this agent is known on each connected system. The office recognizes the agent's own activity only by an exact match with these.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### people[].identities.vcs

Login of this agent on the VCS host, for example "acme-sam[bot]".

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### people[].identities.tracker

Username or id of this agent in the issue tracker.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### people[].identities.chat

Username or id of this agent in the chat workspace.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

### people[].repos

Repository access by repo name, "kind:<primary|baseline|infra|other>" or "*"; values are "read" or "write".

- Type: `map`
- Optional
- Default: `{}`

### people[].tools

Tools for this agent only; they replace team-level tools of the same name.

- Type: `map`
- Optional

#### people[].tools.<key>

A tool installed at agent start, with the commands it may run.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### people[].tools.<key>.version

Exact version to install, for example "1.23.4".

- Type: `string`
- Required

#### people[].tools.<key>.source

Where mise gets the tool, as a mise backend and name such as ubi:vendor/their-cli or npm:their-cli. Defaults to the tool name, which mise looks up in its registry.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Must match `^[a-z0-9_-]+:\S+$`

#### people[].tools.<key>.allow

What the agent may run: "all" (any arguments), a list of first subcommands, or structured rules. Installing a tool allows nothing by itself. The built-in denies still win.

- Type: `string or list of string or list of object`
- Required

#### people[].tools.<key>.allow[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

### people[].avatar

Avatar settings.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### people[].avatar.seed

Seed for a generated avatar.

- Type: `string`
- Optional

#### people[].avatar.url

Image URL to use as the avatar.

- Type: `string`
- Optional

## email

Email addresses for agents.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### email.pattern

Address pattern for agents, for example "{handle}@acme.example".

- Type: `string`
- Required

## office

Office event intake settings.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### office.events

How the office learns about changes: polling or webhooks.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Default: `poll`
- Allowed values: `poll`, `webhook`

### office.poll_interval_seconds

Seconds between polls when events is "poll".

- Type: `integer`
- Optional
- Default: `60`
- Minimum 10
- Maximum 3600

### office.channel

Team chat channel where the office mirrors agent-to-agent questions and answers, so humans can follow them. Without it they go to the ticket of the asking work item, or only to its journal.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

## tools

Tools every agent of the team installs at start, with the commands they may run.

- Type: `map`
- Optional

### tools.<key>

A tool installed at agent start, with the commands it may run.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### tools.<key>.version

Exact version to install, for example "1.23.4".

- Type: `string`
- Required

#### tools.<key>.source

Where mise gets the tool, as a mise backend and name such as ubi:vendor/their-cli or npm:their-cli. Defaults to the tool name, which mise looks up in its registry.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Must match `^[a-z0-9_-]+:\S+$`

#### tools.<key>.allow

What the agent may run: "all" (any arguments), a list of first subcommands, or structured rules. Installing a tool allows nothing by itself. The built-in denies still win.

- Type: `string or list of string or list of object`
- Required

#### tools.<key>.allow[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

## workflow

How work moves through the team.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### workflow.preset

Built-in workflow to start from.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Default: `kanban`
- Allowed values: `kanban`, `scrum`, `minimal`

### workflow.statuses

Maps canonical statuses to the status names used in your tracker.

- Type: `map`
- Optional
- Allowed keys: `backlog`, `ready`, `active`, `review`, `blocked`, `done`, `canceled`

### workflow.rules

Rules added to the preset. A rule with a preset rule's id replaces it; { id, disabled: true } removes it.

- Type: `list of object`
- Optional

### workflow.rules[]

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### workflow.rules[].id

Unique id. A rule with the same id as a preset rule replaces it.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Maximum length 64
- Must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`

#### workflow.rules[].on

Event type or types that trigger the rule.

- Type: `string or list of string`
- Required
- Allowed values: `pr.opened`, `pr.merged`, `pr.closed`, `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment`, `pr.conflicted`, `pr.ci_failed`, `ticket.assigned`, `ticket.moved`, `ticket.commented`, `ticket.created`, `agent.handed_back`, `agent.asked`, `schedule.cron`

#### workflow.rules[].on[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Allowed values: `pr.opened`, `pr.merged`, `pr.closed`, `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment`, `pr.conflicted`, `pr.ci_failed`, `ticket.assigned`, `ticket.moved`, `ticket.commented`, `ticket.created`, `agent.handed_back`, `agent.asked`, `schedule.cron`

## policies

Team-wide guardrails and message style.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

### policies.agent_loop_guard

Stops agents from triggering each other in endless loops. Limits only runs triggered by agents or automation; humans are never limited.

- Type: `object`
- Optional
- Default: `{"max_runs_per_item_per_hour":12}`

#### policies.agent_loop_guard.max_runs_per_item_per_hour

Maximum runs per work item per hour triggered by agents or automation; humans are never limited.

- Type: `integer`
- Optional
- Default: `12`
- Minimum 1

### policies.usage

Thresholds that slow down work as the LLM usage limit approaches.

- Type: `object`
- Optional
- Default: `{"defer_scheduled_at":0.85,"pause_automatic_at":0.95}`

#### policies.usage.defer_scheduled_at

Fraction of the usage limit at which scheduled work is deferred.

- Type: `number`
- Optional
- Default: `0.85`
- Minimum 0
- Maximum 1

#### policies.usage.pause_automatic_at

Fraction of the usage limit at which all automatic work pauses.

- Type: `number`
- Optional
- Default: `0.95`
- Minimum 0
- Maximum 1

#### policies.usage.shared

Groups of people who use one LLM subscription, as lists of handles. A usage report from any member applies to all of them.

- Type: `list of list of string`
- Optional

#### policies.usage.shared[]

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional
- Minimum items 2

#### policies.usage.shared[][]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

### policies.messages

How agents write chat messages.

- Type: `object`
- Optional
- Default: `{"max_lines":3,"always_link":true,"omit":["ci","mergeability","hashes"]}`

#### policies.messages.max_lines

Maximum lines in a chat message from an agent.

- Type: `integer`
- Optional
- Default: `3`
- Minimum 1
- Maximum 20

#### policies.messages.always_link

Link tickets, pull requests and documents instead of mentioning bare ids.

- Type: `boolean`
- Optional
- Default: `true`

#### policies.messages.omit

Details left out of chat messages.

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional
- Default: `["ci","mergeability","hashes"]`
- Allowed values: `ci`, `mergeability`, `hashes`, `file_lists`

#### policies.messages.omit[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Allowed values: `ci`, `mergeability`, `hashes`, `file_lists`

### policies.commands

Extra commands for this team's own tools, on top of the built-in and toolset rules.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.allow

Commands agents may run.

- Type: `list of object`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.allow[]

A command rule.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.allow[].program

Program name, for example make. Git is governed by repository grants.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1
- Must match `^[^\s/]+$`

#### policies.commands.allow[].subcommand

Leading positional words, for example ["pr", "view"].

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional
- Minimum items 1

#### policies.commands.allow[].subcommand[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### policies.commands.allow[].args

Every condition must hold for the rule to apply.

- Type: `list of any`
- Optional
- Minimum items 1

#### policies.commands.allow[].args[]

A condition on the command arguments.

- Type: `any`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.allow[].reason

Why the rule exists; shown when it decides a call.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

#### policies.commands.allow[].requires_repo

The working repository must have at least this grant.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Allowed values: `read`, `write`

#### policies.commands.deny

Commands agents may never run. Deny always wins over allow.

- Type: `list of object`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.deny[]

A command rule.

- Type: `object`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.deny[].program

Program name, for example make. Git is governed by repository grants.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1
- Must match `^[^\s/]+$`

#### policies.commands.deny[].subcommand

Leading positional words, for example ["pr", "view"].

- Type: `list of string`
- Optional
- Minimum items 1

#### policies.commands.deny[].subcommand[]

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Minimum length 1

#### policies.commands.deny[].args

Every condition must hold for the rule to apply.

- Type: `list of any`
- Optional
- Minimum items 1

#### policies.commands.deny[].args[]

A condition on the command arguments.

- Type: `any`
- Optional

#### policies.commands.deny[].reason

Why the rule exists; shown when it decides a call.

- Type: `string`
- Required
- Minimum length 1

#### policies.commands.deny[].requires_repo

The working repository must have at least this grant.

- Type: `string`
- Optional
- Allowed values: `read`, `write`
